verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware security key that stores credentials locally. A hosted sandbox environment that keeps tests away from production data is a SaaS/API concept, so the axis is a category error for this product type. The firmware-development path (flashing and testing against an EVK dev board or a Hacker key) is board-level firmware tooling, not a sandbox environment for production data, so it does not flip the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
